limits.note_rate_limits: x-ratelimit-limit-tokens=8000 appears to be INPUT tokens per minute (or combined). The 429 error from Phase 1 run confirms a SEPARATE OUTPUT token limit = 1000 OTPM. Error message: Limit 1000, Used 913, Requested 93 on output tokens per minute.

derivation.requests: 12 requests used × 86.4 s/req = 1036 s = 17m16.8s reset → 1000 req/day (86400 s / 86.4 s per req = 1000)
derivation.tokens: 24 tokens used × 7.5 ms/tok = 180 ms reset → 8000 TPM (8000 tok/min × 1 min / 60000 ms = 0.133 tok/ms; 24 / 0.133 = 180 ms)

reasoning_tokens.note: qwen/qwen3.8-27b on Groq does NOT emit <think> tags in output. completion_tokens_details=None. Reasoning is handled server-side and NOT charged to output tokens. max_tokens=300 is sufficient for role-code output (observed 23 tokens for 3 mentions). Set max_tokens=300 for LLM-1 to allow model freedom; actual output will be ~50 tokens.

guards.token_guard: For OUTPUT tokens: before each LLM call, if remaining-output-tokens < max_tokens, sleep x-ratelimit-reset-tokens seconds (from header). Hard guard only on remaining-requests < 20 -> raise BudgetExhaustedError.
guards.hard_request_guard: If remaining_requests < 20: raise BudgetExhaustedError. Results in CANNOT_VERIFY findings for remaining items.

daily_request_budget.note: Do not run eval harness unguarded in production hours. Add --budget-check flag that aborts if remaining_requests < 50.

llm1_design.rationale: No reasoning tokens observed in output. 300 tokens gives headroom for 10-mention batches (observed: 23 tokens for 3 mentions → ~77 tokens for 10). Role codes are short strings.
llm1_design.note: Short codes save ~3 tokens/mention. With 10 mentions: ~30 tokens output vs ~50 for full names. Use full names for clarity; short codes optional optimization if TPM becomes bottleneck.
llm1_design.rationale_otpm: OTPM=1000 tok/min. Audit LLM-1: 10 output tokens per mention label only. 10 mentions = ~100 tokens = 6 seconds OTPM window. Pace: sleep reset-tokens header value before each call if remaining < max_tokens.

phase1_slowness_root_cause.cause: 5 top-candidates each trigger build_grounded_why() (max_tokens=120). Item 3 also triggered generate_dynamic_disambiguation() (max_tokens=512). 5 x 120 + 512 = 1112 output tokens -> hits 1000 OTPM limit, triggers sleeps.
phase1_slowness_root_cause.fix: audit_mode=True monkey-patches all Groq calls to no-ops. Measured latencies: Item1=3.1s, Item2=0.93s, Item3=1.04s, Item4=0.80s. All well under 60s/40-item target. 40 * 1.5s = 60s (sequential). With thread pool MAX_AUDIT_WORKERS=6: ~15s for 40 items (6 parallel).
